InitGenerator.name: Init generator sprite
summary: Level sprites $CB-$D9: records the generator type in [$18B9] = sprite number - $CA, marks the sprite not loaded in the level table and loads the next sprite.
Also holds the shell ($DA-$E0) and cluster ($E1+) hand-off at $02A8C0 and the shooter hand-off at $02A8D4.

LoadNormalSprite.name: Spawn sprite from level data
summary: Finds a free sprite slot (honouring the reserved-slot ranges of the current sprite memory setting [$1692]) and fills it from the level data at [$CE],Y.
Sets position, status ([$04]), sprite number (shells $DA-$DD become Koopas 4-7 with status 9; Koopas recolour if [$1EEB] bit 7), level index [$161A,X],
and runs InitSpriteTables. With the silver P-switch active ([$14AE]) most sprites turn into moving coins instead.
If no slot is free the sprite is marked unloaded so it is tried again. Jumps back into LoadSpriteLoopStrt.

FindFreeSlotLowPri.name: Find free sprite slot, keep 2 free
summary: Sets [$0E] = 2 so FindFreeSlotRt leaves the last two slots unused, then falls into FindFreeSprSlot.
Returns: A and Y = slot, or $FF if none. Long call (RTL).

FindFreeSprSlot.name: Find free sprite slot
summary: Long-call wrapper around FindFreeSlotRt with [$0E] = 0 and the data bank set to $02.
Returns: A and Y = free slot number, or $FF.

FindFreeSlotRt.name: Search for free sprite slot
summary: Searches downward from SpriteSlotMax - [$0E] to SpriteSlotStart for status 0 in [$14C8,X]; slot range depends on [$1692].
Parameters: [$0E] = number of top slots to skip. Returns: Y = free slot or $FF.

s02AA33.name: Spawn cluster type 8 (15 entries)
summary: Reached through the jump stub at $02AABD for sprite $E4 (the original label says unreachable, but it is entered via that stub).
Fills 15 cluster entries with random X near the screen and a Y from the level byte.

s02AA6C.name: Spawn cluster type 5 (4 entries)
summary: For sprite $E6: sets [$14CB] = 7 and initialises four cluster sprites with fixed X positions, Y = $F0.

s02AABD.name: Jump stub to cluster type 8 spawner
summary: JMP $02AA33 stored as data; the BEQ at $02AAC7 branches onto it as code.

s02AAC0.name: Load cluster sprites
summary: Handles sprites $E1-$E6: sets [$18B8] = 1 and dispatches by number. $E1 = 20 type 3 entries (random position),
$E2/$E3 = up to two groups of 10 type 4 entries, $E4 = type 8, $E5 = type 7, $E6 = type 5.
Parameters: A = sprite number, [$03] = data index. Cluster type names are unconfirmed.

LoadShooter.name: Load shooter, clear sprites, preload level
summary: Loads a shooter (sprites $C9-$CA) into one of 8 slots at $1783 (type = number - $C8, position from level data, timer $10); a full table replaces round-robin ([$18FF]).
$02ABF2: called on level exit; clears all level load flags, keeps a carried sprite (status $0B) in slot 0, clears RAM $1693-$190D.
$02AC5C: preloads all sprites around the screen by calling CODE_02A802 over 32 steps of $10 pixels, vertical or horizontal depending on the level.

GivePoints.name: Spawn score sprite
summary: $02ACE5 (GivePoints): A = score type - 5, X = sprite slot that was hit. $02ACE1: same with Y as the sprite slot.
$02ACEF: creates the score sprite at the sprite's position, 8 pixels higher; type 1=10, 2=20, 3=40, 4=80, 5=100 ... 9=1000, A=2000, B=4000, C=8000, D=1UP.
$02AD34: returns Y = free score slot (6 slots), or round-robin slot [$18F7].

PointTile1.name: Table: score sprite left tiles
summary: Tile for the left half of each score type (0-$15).

PointTile2.name: Table: score sprite right tiles
summary: Tile for the right half of each score type (0-$15).

PointMultiplierLo.name: Table: score value low byte
summary: Score divided by 10 for each type, low byte.

PointMultiplierHi.name: Table: score value high byte
summary: Score divided by 10 for each type, high byte.

PointSpeedY.name: Table: score sprite speeds and OAM slots
summary: PointSpeedY: 4 bytes. DATA_02AD9E: 6 OAM indices, one per score sprite. Exact use is unconfirmed.

ScoreSprGfx.name: Update score sprites
summary: Loops over the six score sprite slots and runs the update/draw routine for each active one. Skips everything for Bowser's room ([$0D9B] = $C1).
Hides OAM entries 1-2 in other Mode 7 boss rooms (bit 6 of [$0D9B]). The routine beyond $02ADD5 is in the next chunk.

Instr02ADCB.name: Data: BEQ opcode bytes inside score update
summary: F0 03 is a BEQ +3 that the disassembler shows as data.

Instr02ADD3.name: Data: BNE opcode bytes inside score update
summary: D0 0F is a BNE +$0F that the disassembler shows as data.

CoinsToGive.name: Table: coins given by coin type
summary: Probably the number of coins awarded per coin sprite/block type.
